projects.name: Therapeia - VR Therapy and mobile app
projects.summary: A VR therapy platform that brings Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and exposure therapy into a fully immersive, therapist-guided virtual environment. With AI-driven data analysis, progress tracking, and real-time physiological monitoring, therapists and patients gain valuable insights to enhance treatment effectiveness—all from the comfort of your home.
highlights: Leading development of a VR therapy platform, managing framework design, unit testing, and UX implementation.
Enhanced 3D environments with interactive features for personalized client and therapist experiences.
Built immersive, cost-effective solution using Unity, C#, Flutter, Spring Boot, .NET, GitHub, and Visual Studio.

projects.name: Fox vs. Zombies - 3D Third-Person Shooter Game

Designed core gameplay features like score-based progression, time-based checkpoints, and trigger-based animations.
Integrated custom models, music, and UI for a polished and engaging player experience.
